name: mcp-server-canvas-lms
description: Read your Canvas courses, assignments and feedback, with text from PDFs, Word documents and PowerPoint slides.
long_description:
A minimal, student-focused, strictly read-only MCP server for Canvas LMS.

Ask Claude about your courses, upcoming assignments, grades and instructor feedback, announcements, syllabi, modules, pages, and course files, including text from PDF, Word and PowerPoint documents with source references. Every Canvas request is an HTTP GET: this server cannot submit assignments, send messages, change grades, or modify anything in Canvas.

You need your institution's Canvas URL (for example https://canvas.example.edu) and a Canvas personal access token (Canvas → Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → New Access Token). The token is stored securely by Claude Desktop and is only ever sent to your Canvas server.

canvas_base_url.title: Canvas URL
canvas_base_url.description: Your institution's Canvas address, e.g. https://canvas.example.edu — the site root only, without /api/v1 or a course path.

canvas_api_token.title: Canvas access token
canvas_api_token.description: A personal access token from Canvas → Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → New Access Token. Stored securely and sent only to your Canvas server.

tools.name: canvas_get_weekly_overview
tools.description: Get upcoming deadlines, overdue work, completion to verify and recent announcements across active courses, with source links and coverage notices.

tools.name: canvas_list_courses
tools.description: List active courses, terms, and available current scores.

tools.name: canvas_list_assignments
tools.description: List assignments for one course or all active courses.

tools.name: canvas_get_assignment
tools.description: Read one assignment's requirements, rubric, and submission summary.

tools.name: canvas_get_grades
tools.description: Read grade totals or one course's assignment breakdown.

tools.name: canvas_get_submission
tools.description: Read the current user's submission, comments, and rubric assessment.

tools.name: canvas_get_syllabus
tools.description: Read one course syllabus as cleaned text.

tools.name: canvas_list_announcements
tools.description: List recent announcements for one or all active courses.

tools.name: canvas_list_modules
tools.description: List one course's modules and module items.

tools.name: canvas_get_page
tools.description: Read one course page by its Canvas page URL slug.

tools.name: canvas_list_files
tools.description: List files in one course with an optional search term.

tools.name: canvas_read_file
tools.description: Read a course file, extracting PDF, DOCX and PPTX text with source references; other files are safely downloaded.
